subject: Judge: review suggest_links semantic+rerank swap
description:
self-learn-judge in SINGLE-ATTEMPT review mode against the impl attempt branch orch/attempt/<impl-key> (the "Switch suggest_links to semantic scorer + cross-encoder rerank" task). The review IS the verdict.

Fetch the attempt diff (get_attempt_diff) and apply the code-review rubric: correctness, scope discipline (suggest_links ONLY — flag any change to the cloud search box or unrelated surfaces), dead/redundant code (the old lexical scoreMatches path should be removed or justified, not left dangling), test presence/quality (test/suggest-rerank.test.js covers semantic-by-default, rerank default-on null-safe fallback, shared-token evidence, recalibrated dup threshold), and style.

SPECIAL FOCUS — the duplicate-threshold recalibration: verify the new dup flag uses a COSINE-scale threshold, not the lexical SUGGEST_DUP_THRESHOLD. A mis-scaled threshold (e.g. reusing the lexical bar on cosine) is a correctness bug — kick it back. Also verify rerank is genuinely null-safe (sidecar-down must NOT break suggestions).

Either APPROVE (hold-merge verdict — record, do not force-merge) or KICK BACK (set_status failed + a wired record_decision explaining what to fix). NEVER force-merge; merge stays git merge --no-ff and auto-aborts on conflict. Pass wires_to=[this judge task key] on any record_decision.
